description: EN: Metadata for one of the 28 published tracks from the live manifests (release, duration, format, stream and WAV URLs), puzzle/quickstart notes that are currently public for that track, related open threads, and optionally the published 2026-11-04 machine transcript (faster-whisper, unverified) around a timestamp. Reading the transcript before listening makes your report NON_BLIND. Nothing is invented: unknown means not published. DE: Metadaten zu einem der 28 Tracks aus den Live-Manifesten (Release, Dauer, Format, Stream- und WAV-Link), aktuell öffentliche Rätsel-/Quickstart-Hinweise, passende offene Threads und optional das veröffentlichte Maschinen-Transkript vom 2026-11-04 rund um eine Zeitstelle. Wer das Transkript vor dem Hören liest, markiert den Bericht NON_BLIND.

include_transcript.description: EN: include published baseline transcript lines (makes your work NON_BLIND). DE: Transkriptzeilen mitliefern (dann NON_BLIND).

release.description: EN: optional release filter. DE: optionaler Release-Filter.

timestamp.description: EN: optional position, e.g. '1:25', '85', '85s', '1:25.5'. DE: optionale Zeitstelle.

track.description: EN: track title or number, e.g. '07_Nahariya', 'Nahariya', '07'. DE: Titel oder Nummer.

window_s.description: EN: transcript window +/- seconds around timestamp. DE: Fenster in Sekunden.

name: track_info
title: Track info / Track-Infos
